thread:
maria (support): /cc @ben customer 11921 reports our A/B rollout dashboard shows swapped variant counts for experiment 'pricing-cta' starting ~2026-03-01T02:12 UTC. Screenshot: https://redwood/report/11921/snap.png They say UI shows B >> A but their raw assignment ledger shows A > B.
ben (eng-analytics): Got it. Can you paste exact window + any sample request ids from the customer? Also any recent deploys around that time?
maria (support): Customer steps: Console -> Experiments -> pricing-cta -> last 24h. Root event they cited at 2026-03-01T02:12:23Z. Ticket has sample user ids: u123, u987, u222.
leo (frontend): I shipped a small mapping change yesterday that switched label-by-index instead of label-by-id for experiment UI. Rolling it back to confirm.
deploy-bot: deploy recorded: frontend/experiments@v3.12.4 by leo (frontend) at 1893498000
nora (data-eng): I see something in the ingest logs for that exact window — consumer deserializer had a schema rollout and field order changed on partition 7. Some events parsed variant_id from the wrong field index. Example log:
```
2026-03-01T02:12:24Z consumer-7 WARN deserializer - field_order_mismatch=true partition=7 offset=1254124
payload: {user_id: 'u123', variant_id: 'v_b', fields: ['v_b','meta','v_b']}
```
If downstream joins assume fixed position for variant_id, that could shift labels.
ben (eng-analytics): Can you run a quick check to compare assignments_raw.variant_id vs ledger.assigned_variant for that window? I also ran a query and saw an off-by-index mapping impacting ~8% of assignment events between 02:12-02:30 UTC.
maria (support): Customer says ~3k users affected. They want ETA and whether dashboard counts are trustworthy for decisions.
nora (data-eng): Short-term workaround: recompute assignment from deterministic hash of user_id + experiment_id and ignore the parsed variant field for the affected window. Example SQL to compute stable assignment:
```
SELECT experiment_id,
  CASE WHEN XXH64(CONCAT(user_id, experiment_id)) % 100 < allocation_pct THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS variant,
  COUNT(*)
FROM events
WHERE ingest_ts >= '2026-03-01T02:00:00Z' AND ingest_ts < '2026-03-01T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
We'll run a backfill to overwrite assignment rows for 02:12-02:30 and then re-run aggregations for the dashboard.
leo (frontend): Confirmed the frontend label-by-index change caused some UI mismatches for experiments where server variant ids aren't contiguous. Hotfix coming.
deploy-bot: deploy recorded: frontend/experiments@v3.12.5-hotfix by leo (frontend) at 1893503000
ben (eng-analytics): After backfill we need to re-run dashboard aggregation and refresh caches. Nora, can you kick re-agg and ping me when ready so I can trigger refresh?
nora (data-eng): Yep. Starting reprocess for partition offsets 1254000-1254200. ETA ~45 minutes. If it's heavy we'll do incremental and prioritize the pricing-cta experiment.
maria (support): I'll update the customer: ETA 45m, temporary manual query they've requested (above) and advise to not make decisions on dashboard until we confirm. Updates in ticket.
leo (frontend): Note to self: add integration test asserting deserializer field-order invariants and a UI fallback if parsed label missing.
ben (eng-analytics): Also adding an alert for 'event field mismatch rate' > 0.5% so we catch this early.
maria (support): Ticket 11921 updated with root cause, workaround, and ETA. I'll close the loop when backfill + re-agg complete. Thanks everyone :pray:
